items.prompt: 我在看当前目录的 source.md。JSONL 不就是一行一行往后写吗，Pi 怎么还能在同一个文件里分叉？
facts: physical storage is append-only JSONL
id/parentId form a logical tree
new branch entries append rather than erase old lines
model context follows the selected ancestry and applies compaction
forbidden: claim that branching rewrites or truncates the JSONL

items.prompt: 我在看当前目录的 source.md。Turn 和 Step 我老是混：模型先读一次文件、再改一次文件、最后回答，这到底算几个？
facts: one Turn spans user input to final no-tool answer
each model request/response is a Step
tool results cause another Step within the same Turn
parallel calls in one response remain one Step
forbidden: count every tool call as a separate Turn

items.prompt: 我在看当前目录的 source.md。Extension、Skill、prompt template 看起来都能扩展 Pi，它们到底是不是一回事？如果我要真正拦住危险命令，该选哪个？
facts: Extension is executable host code
Skill is model-facing instruction
prompt template expands user-selected prompt text
enforcement belongs on the executable tool path, so Extension is appropriate
forbidden: claim that a Skill enforces the tool boundary equivalently

items.prompt: 我在看当前目录的 source.md。Agent 和 Runner 不都是在跑模型吗？为什么要分成两个，Session 又放在哪一层？
facts: Agent is a reusable behavior/capability definition
Runner owns the execution loop
Session persists conversation history across runs
the three have distinct lifecycles
forbidden: say that Agent executes itself
equate Session with tracing

items.prompt: 我在看当前目录的 source.md。把专家 Agent 当成 tool，和 handoff 给这个 Agent，本质差在哪？我什么时候容易选错？
facts: manager retains conversation control for agents-as-tools
manager synthesizes the final answer
handoff changes the current Agent
choice depends on whether specialist supplies a result or takes ownership
forbidden: describe both patterns as equivalent delegation

items.prompt: 我在看当前目录的 source.md。既然 tracing 已经能看到模型和工具做了什么，为什么还需要 guardrail？
facts: tracing observes and records
guardrails can block on the execution path
input/output/tool guardrails have different scopes
parallel input checks trade lower latency for a speculative execution window
forbidden: claim that tracing itself blocks execution

items.prompt: 我在看当前目录的 source.md。DSH 里的 Profile、Bundle、Patch 我还是分不清，它们分别是文件、包，还是运行中的对象？
facts: Patch is an incremental entry-list operation/config layer
Bundle is an npm package whose manifest points to a patch
Profile is a launchable directory/composition selecting ordered bundles
runtime plugin instances appear only after composition and loading
forbidden: reduce Bundle to merely a list of patches
call Profile a runtime plugin instance

items.prompt: 我在看当前目录的 source.md。为什么一个类里调用 `super(ctx, 'llm')`，别的插件后面就能写 `ctx.llm`？`inject: ['llm']` 又做了什么？
facts: Service constructor provides the instance under a name
Context Proxy resolves ctx.llm through the service store
inject declares an availability dependency rather than constructing the object
Fiber owns plugin activation and cleanup
forbidden: say that the string llm is converted into an object
guarantee unspecified dependent-unload behavior

items.prompt: 我在看当前目录的 source.md。`model-visible means logged` 到底是什么意思？Headless 为什么不能直接打印模型调用刚返回的字符串？
facts: model-visible semantic content must have a Session event
logged diagnostic events need not be model-visible
model conversation is a projection of recorded events
Headless flushes and derives text/end reason from the owned event interval
forbidden: claim that every logged event is model-visible
treat a transient model return as authoritative durable final state

items.prompt: 我在看当前目录的 source.md。抗体或者免疫细胞是不是碰到病毒以后，才现场做出一个刚好匹配它的受体？
facts: diverse receptors exist before exposure
antigen selects a matching pre-existing clone
selected clones proliferate
descendants preserve specificity
forbidden: describe antigen as designing the receptor

items.prompt: 我在看当前目录的 source.md。T 细胞都已经认出抗原了，为什么资料还说它不一定会被激活？
facts: TCR recognizes peptide plus self MHC
recognition and activation are distinct
naive T-cell activation generally also needs professional-APC costimulation
missing costimulation breaks the activation chain
forbidden: equate binding with full activation

items.prompt: 我在看当前目录的 source.md。免疫记忆是不是就是血里一直留着很多上次产生的抗体？
facts: persistent antibody alone is incomplete
long-lived antigen-specific memory cells remain
secondary response starts from a larger/more responsive specific population
memory does not generally accelerate unrelated antigens
forbidden: describe immune memory as nonspecific
attribute it solely to circulating antibody

items.prompt: 我在看当前目录的 source.md。会计里的借方是不是增加、贷方是不是减少？为什么不同例子看起来反过来了？
facts: debit and credit mean left and right
increase direction depends on account type
assets/expenses usually increase by debit
liabilities/equity/revenue usually increase by credit
total debits equal total credits
forbidden: define debit universally as increase

items.prompt: 我在看当前目录的 source.md。公司明明有利润，为什么还可能发不出工资、现金不够？
facts: accrual profit and cash timing differ
credit revenue can increase receivables before cash
collection later converts receivable to cash without new revenue
cash obligations can precede collection
forbidden: equate positive profit with positive cash balance

items.prompt: 我在看当前目录的 source.md。买机器明明当场花了一大笔钱，为什么利润表不在当期把它全部算成费用？
facts: cash decreases while property/equipment increases
purchase is an investing cash outflow
multi-period benefit leads to depreciation over periods
depreciation reduces profit without a new cash payment that period
forbidden: treat the entire purchase as immediate operating expense
